An '''electro-shock prosthetic hand''' was a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic implant]]. The hands were capable of delivering electrical shocks at the owner's discretion. [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Central Commander]] [[Sollaine]] had two electro-shock prosthetic hands to replace his organic ones.<ref name="SF">{{JournalCite|12|Small Favors}}</ref>
